📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Adaeze just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Luz just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Adaeze just put down The Suburb... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Grażyna was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Leo taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Nikos has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Leo drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Nikos: "The european elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
Leo: "European Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

📚 Village knowledge: Olivia taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Adaeze has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Olivia passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.

📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
